subject: estimated sex of individuals using hcov

messages.author: b1736a687c8441ac
messages.subject: estimated sex of individuals using hcov
parts:
Hi all
I'm using secr to investigate density and sex-specific home range size of wild felids with camera trapping data. 
As expected, we have some individuals with unknown sex, so I used hcov=Sex to deal with it. I didn't quite get how to obtain the estimated sex for such individuals from the output of secr.fit.
Thanks a lot.
Vale

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: estimated sex of individuals using hcov
parts:
Hello Valentina
The package 'openCR' offers a method 'classMembership' for completely unknown latent classes, but openCR.fit() does not allow partially known classes (hcov). What you need is the 'secr' version of classMembership, but unfortunately it doesn't exist. It's simple enough in principle (just capture the individual likelihood components given membership in each class and see which is bigger), but because 'secr' has many options there is quite a lot of coding involved and it won't happen soon.
Murray
